candidates_added.why: Literal C_δ = (0.15||g||)^2 I makes typical ||δ|| ≈ 0.15√N ||g|| > 2||g|| in 204-D and destroys localization even noiseless. A 15%-of-vector-norm reading is an essential forensic alternative. Not called paper-faithful. The bioRxiv preprint instead says δ was set “to have variance equal to 15% of gm0’s norm”, which is itself ambiguous but closer to a norm-relative perturbation than to an isotropic N-dimensional blow-up.
candidates_added.source: Published paper: Σ=σ²I, σ=0.15||g||. Preprint: variance equal to 15% of gm0’s norm. No recoverable Ossadtchi 2018 drop-in for this RDM recipe.

The first finished n_mc=100 file (seed 20240904, SNR=0.1) is the first generation setting under fixed AIRI-SPoC that is not pathologically far from the paper (AUC 0.836, TPR@0.01 0.296, median loc. 0.88 cm). findings: Fig. 5 caption: C=6; body: C=5. Both remain as labeled external generation branches (C=6-generated subsets vs C=5-from-scratch).
Captions say 100 MC trials. I_c is printed only as a symbol. Fig. 4 panel titles include “100 trials”; I_c=100 is a post-review candidate, not pre-registered.
Published δ: normally distributed with covariance σ²I, σ=0.15||g||. Preprint: variance equal to 15% of ||g||. Literal high-D blow-up is documented; norm-15% is forensic category D.
SNR: singular γ; “ratio of root mean powers between these two matrices” supports one global γ per realization. Per-trial γ is the original SIM-P1 reconstruction.

1000 randomly seeded cortical 1/f sources; each trial a new spatially correlated noise realization. Locations-once vs redraw-every-epoch both remain plausible. Ossadtchi 2018 public PSIICOS sim is not this RDM recipe.
Figs 13–15: first three statistically significant components (not “exactly three were significant”). Fig. 17: three lowest-p components, then Fig. 18 uses that subspace.
